name: huggingcode
description: Cross-platform multi-provider coding agent with safe trajectory, secure key storage, token economy, and Tauri desktop app.

scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:prepare-runtime && tauri build --config desktop/tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop:prepare-runtime && tauri build --config desktop/tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles app,dmg
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run desktop:prepare-runtime && tauri build --config desktop/tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles appimage,deb
